answer: Unrepeatable answer challenge: each agent must solve a fresh, seeded problem whose solution is checked against a registry of prior responses. A voyage of identical sybil answers collapses because the registry rejects duplicates, forcing each fake identity to produce novel, hard-won output. Reaching the summit of registration requires a unique proof-of-work answer whose generation cost is paid per identity. A lantern check then verifies the answer was never reused, so an attacker pays full compute for every identity, making duplication economically flat.
